title: Здоровый рацион
subject: A fresh, vivid red apple with a green leaf, one yellow pear and a little cluster of blueberries, naturally arranged on a small mossy patch. Hero object: fruit still life. No plate, utensils, sweets, words, symbols or crossed-out marks.

title: Ранний старт
subject: A freestanding miniature ivory window frame with two open deep-teal wooden shutters, warm peach dawn light shining softly through the opening, a tiny fresh sprig on its sill. Hero silhouette is a tall open window. No clock, sun disk, bed, book or landscape background.

title: Ледяная закалка
subject: A sturdy wooden cold-water bucket with copper hoops, slightly tipped as crystal-clear icy-blue water splashes outward, with three clear ice cubes and subtle frosty mist. Hero silhouette is a bucket and flowing water. No snowflake badge, person or shower stall.

title: Сила отжиманий
subject: Two substantial low push-up handles / parallettes with carved dark-teal grips, warm copper brackets and ivory feet, positioned at different angles on a small patch of smooth stone. Clearly exercise equipment for push-ups. No people, dumbbells, kettlebell, sneakers or yoga mat.

title: Голос души
subject: One elegant vintage studio microphone with dark-teal grille, ivory and copper body, on a short curved copper desktop stand. Two small jade sound-wave arcs beside the microphone. Hero silhouette is a tall microphone. No headphones, speakers, musical notes, people or lettering.

title: Танцевальный ритм
subject: A beautiful hanging mirrored disco ball made of tiny teal, silver and warm-copper square tiles, with a short copper loop above and several soft blue-gold light glints below. Hero silhouette is a faceted sphere. No microphone, headphones, shoes, dancers or big music notes. Fully self-contained transparent asset.

title: Финансовый порядок
subject: A half-open dark-teal leather wallet with neat copper stitching, several tidy gold-copper coins stacked beside it and two ivory banknotes tucked inside without currency symbols or text. Hero silhouette is horizontal wallet and coins. No books, pens, calculator or receipts.

title: Чистое рабочее место
subject: A tidy wooden desktop organizer holding three ivory and teal pencils, beside a folded jade cleaning cloth and a small natural-bristle brush. Warm polished wood, copper trim. Compact clean tabletop vignette, all self-contained with no large table or room. No laptop, book, plant or phone.

title: Без телефона
subject: A dark-teal smartphone placed face-down inside an open small ivory wooden storage box with a copper latch; phone back and single camera lens visible, box lid angled back. One delicate green leaf beside the box. Hero silhouette is an open phone storage box. No clock, lock icon, crossed-out circle, lettering or paper.

title: Поделиться прогрессом
subject: A single expressive five-point warm-copper and ivory star with a deep-teal inset, gently wrapped by two slim flowing teal ribbons pointing outward like sharing paths. Small copper light specks only. Hero silhouette is a prominent sculpted star. No rocket, aircraft, arrow icon, trophy, stairs or writing.

title: Языковой прогресс
subject: Three sculpted ivory and dark-teal alphabet learning blocks arranged in a playful small stack, engraved with one large A, one Б and one 文 respectively, copper-edged engraving. One small rounded teal speech bubble behind the blocks. Hero silhouette is a trio of letter blocks. No books, globe, pencils, phones or human figures.

title: Дневник мыслей
subject: A gently unfurled ivory parchment scroll with a deep-teal fountain pen resting diagonally across it, and a tiny copper-rimmed jade ink bottle. Subtle short unreadable handwritten strokes on paper, no legible words. Hero silhouette is a scroll and pen, NOT a book. No wallet, coins, desk organizer or alphabet blocks.

title: На новом уровне
subject: Three ascending substantial carved-jade steps with ivory sides and copper edge trim, ending at an elegant copper flagpole with one small deep-teal flag marked with clearly legible 25. A few tiny moss leaves at the bottom. Hero silhouette is a rising staircase and flag. No mountain, stone path, star, rocket, trophy, medallion or other numbers.
